title: craspedia aurantia var. jamesii
intro: Craspedia aurantia var. jamesii, commonly known as the yellow button or Billy button, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its bright yellow, button-like flowers that provide a burst of color and energy to any environment. The leaves and flowers of Craspedia aurantia var. jamesii have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving immune function due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids and terpenoids, exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
